about: The moved variant: the same project a day later, scanned again after the code changed. Decisions and edits made on the first run stay where they were written, so some of them no longer sit on a site of the new run. A move with a snippet changes the site's key (the engine finds it next to the old one and shows the old decision and edit beside it as stale). A move with only a line leaves the key alone. A new site is one the first run did not have.

moves.snippet: let q = format!("SELECT id FROM orders WHERE state = '{}'", state);
